relations.subject: Barbara E. Ward

relations.evidence: She taught sociology at Chinese University of Hong Kong, rising to the rank of reader.

relations.subject: Barbara E. Ward
relations.evidence: In 1973, she was invited to act as the head of the International Institute for Environmental Affairs.
